name: acceptance-overlap-proves-one-intersection-not-a-reader-floor
body: The phase-03 acceptance `plan_verify_passes_beside_a_concurrent_read_only_reader` proves at least one observed reader/verify interval intersection per round from a continuously looped reader, not a minimum reader-invocation count per round, and it manufactures overlap by the pre-verify rendezvous (one completed reader invocation) plus the loop rather than by sleeping; a pathological scheduler that fitted an entire verify into the microsecond gap between two reader invocations would fail the overlap assertion rather than false-pass, so the acceptance is conservative. Upgrade to a per-round minimum-invocation assertion if CI ever needs a stronger concurrency floor.
